description: Write msDS-KeyCredentialLink (Shadow Credentials) to obtain a certificate for PKINIT auth as the target.

telemetry.detail: msDS-KeyCredentialLink attribute write - logged only under DS-change auditing (default OFF).
Kerberos TGT request via PKINIT (certificate) following the abuse - certificate pre-auth is an anomaly signal.
Quieter than a password reset (no state the user sees), but modern ITDR (MDI) increasingly flags KeyCredentialLink writes.

abuse_primitive: Write key credential (Whisker/Certipy shadow-creds), request cert, PKINIT to TGT.
notes: Stealth path of choice for GenericAll/GenericWrite over accounts. Loud where DS-change auditing or MDI is present; quiet otherwise.
